headline: Fal's funding round values it at $16 billion, Bloomberg reported
body: Fal, a San Francisco-based startup that hosts and runs AI video, image and audio models, has raised $1.3 billion in its latest funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners. The deal values Fal at $16 billion, double its $8 billion valuation in April, Bloomberg reported. Bloomberg also reported that Fal surpassed $800 million in annualized revenue earlier this year.
note: Other inference providers are growing fast too, but their gross margins remain thin because compute is expensive, according to several people familiar with their financials.

evidence.text: Fal , a San Francisco-based startup that hosts and runs AI video, image, and audio models, has raised $1.3 billion in its latest funding round led by Bessemer Venture Partners, with participation from Nvidia, Sound Ventures, and T. Rowe Price. The deal values Fal at $16 billion, double its $8 billion valuation in April, Bloomberg reported .
Fal surpassed $800 million in annualized revenue earlier this year, Bloomberg’s report noted.

Companies providing inference services, including Baseten, Fireworks AI, and Modal, have also been growing rapidly and raising large funding rounds at higher valuations . But their gross margins remain thin because of the high cost of buying or leasing compute, according to several people familiar with inference companies’ financials.
